verses.text: Then Zophar from Naamah answered:
"My troubled thoughts make me answer, because I am very upset inside.
I have heard your insults, which put me to shame, and my understanding tells me how to answer.
Surely you know that ever since long ago, since people were first put on the earth,
the happiness of evil people is short, and the joy of godless people lasts only a moment.
Even if their pride reaches up to the heavens and their heads touch the clouds,
they will disappear forever, like their own dung. Those who knew them will ask, 'Where are they?'
They fly away like a dream and cannot be found. They are chased away like a vision in the night.
The eyes that saw them will not see them again. Their home will never see them again.
Their children will have to beg the poor for help. They will have to give back the wealth they took.
Their bodies were once full of youthful strength, but that strength will lie with them in the dust.
Evil tastes sweet in their mouths, so they hide it under their tongues.
They enjoy it and do not want to let it go. They keep it in their mouths.
But their food turns sour in their stomachs. It becomes like snake poison inside them.
They swallowed riches, but they will throw them up. God will make their stomachs give them back.
They will suck snake poison. A poisonous snake's fangs will kill them.
They will never enjoy the streams, the rivers flowing with honey and cream.
They will have to give back what they worked for without eating it. They will not enjoy the profits from their trading.
This is because they crushed the poor and left them with nothing. They took over houses they did not build.
Their greed was never satisfied, so they will not be able to save any of the things they loved.
Nothing was left after they had eaten it all, so their wealth will not last.
Even when they have plenty, trouble will catch up with them. The full force of misery will come on them.
When they have filled their stomachs, God will pour out his burning anger on them. It will rain down on them while they eat.
They may run from an iron weapon, but a bronze arrow will pierce them.
They pull it out of their backs, the shining point out of their liver. Terror comes over them.
Total darkness is waiting for their treasures. A fire no one has lit will burn them up and destroy everything left in their tents.
The heavens will show their guilt, and the earth will stand up against them.
A flood will carry away their houses, rushing waters on the day of God's anger.
This is what God has planned for evil people. This is what God has given them as their share."
